```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

# Scan all downloaded covers in data directory
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.jpg$") |> 
  sort()

# Format filename into clean readable label
format_name <- \(x) {
  x |> 
    str_remove("\\.jpg$") |> 
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |> 
    str_to_title()
}

albums_df <- tibble(
  file = files,
  label = map_chr(files, format_name)
)
```

<p class="lead text-muted" style="margin-bottom: 1.25rem; font-size: 1.05rem;">Select any two covers from the catalog to compare composition, lighting key, and chromatic palettes.</p>

# Generate option tags for Album A
default_a <- if ("the_beatles_abbey_road.jpg" %in% files) "the_beatles_abbey_road.jpg" else files[1]

walk2(albums_df$file, albums_df$label, \(f, lbl) {
  selected <- if (f == default_a) " selected" else ""
  cat(sprintf('<option value="%s"%s>%s</option>\n', f, selected, lbl))
})

```{=html}
<script>
let currentMode = 'split';

function updateCovers() {
  const fileA = document.getElementById('selectA').value;
  const fileB = document.getElementById('selectB').value;
  const pathA = 'data/' + fileA;
  const pathB = 'data/' + fileB;

  // Split view images
  document.getElementById('splitImgTop').src = pathA;
  document.getElementById('splitImgBottom').src = pathB;

  // Side view images and badges
  document.getElementById('sideImgA').src = pathA;
  document.getElementById('sideImgB').src = pathB;
  const selA = document.getElementById('selectA');
  const selB = document.getElementById('selectB');
  const labelA = selA.options[selA.selectedIndex].text;
  const labelB = selB.options[selB.selectedIndex].text;
  const badgeA = document.getElementById('sideBadgeA');
  const badgeB = document.getElementById('sideBadgeB');
  if (badgeA) badgeA.textContent = labelA;
  if (badgeB) badgeB.textContent = labelB;

  // Extract color palettes
  extractPalette(pathA, 'paletteSwatchesA', 'paletteTitleA', 'selectA');
  extractPalette(pathB, 'paletteSwatchesB', 'paletteTitleB', 'selectB');

  // Describe similarities and differences
  runAnalysis(pathA, pathB, fileA, fileB);
}

function updateSplit(pct) {
  document.getElementById('splitTop').style.width = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('sliderHandle').style.left = pct + '%';
}

function setMode(mode) {
  currentMode = mode;
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  stage.classList.remove('side-mode');
  if (mode === 'side') stage.classList.add('side-mode');

  document.getElementById('splitViewer').style.display = mode === 'split' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('sideViewer').style.display = mode === 'side' ? 'grid' : 'none';

  ['btnSplit', 'btnSide'].forEach(id => {
    document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active');
  });

  if (mode === 'split') document.getElementById('btnSplit').classList.add('active');
  if (mode === 'side') document.getElementById('btnSide').classList.add('active');
}

function randomize() {
  const selA = document.getElementById('selectA');
  const selB = document.getElementById('selectB');
  const count = selA.options.length;
  if (count < 2) return;

  const idxA = Math.floor(Math.random() * count);
  let idxB = Math.floor(Math.random() * count);
  while (idxB === idxA) {
    idxB = Math.floor(Math.random() * count);
  }

  selA.selectedIndex = idxA;
  selB.selectedIndex = idxB;
  updateCovers();
}

function extractPalette(src, targetRowId, titleId, selectId) {
  const sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
  if (!sel || sel.selectedIndex < 0) return;
  const label = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text;
  const titleEl = document.getElementById(titleId);
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = label;

  const row = document.getElementById(targetRowId);
  if (!row) return;

  const img = new Image();
  const buildPalette = function() {
    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 40;
      canvas.height = 40;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 40, 40);
      const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 40, 40).data;

      // Cluster pixels into color bins to discover prominent tones
      const bins = {};
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 8) {
        const r = Math.min(255, Math.round(data[i] / 24) * 24);
        const g = Math.min(255, Math.round(data[i+1] / 24) * 24);
        const b = Math.min(255, Math.round(data[i+2] / 24) * 24);
        const key = `${r},${g},${b}`;
        bins[key] = (bins[key] || 0) + 1;
      }
      let topColors = Object.entries(bins).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10).map(x => x[0]);

      // If fewer than 10 bins, sample spatially across the image to fill to 10
      if (topColors.length < 10) {
        const coords = [
          [4,4],[12,6],[20,4],[28,6],[36,4],
          [6,20],[14,20],[20,20],[26,20],[34,20],
          [8,34],[16,34],[24,34],[32,34]
        ];
        coords.forEach(([x, y]) => {
          if (topColors.length >= 10) return;
          const idx = (y * 40 + x) * 4;
          const c = `${data[idx]},${data[idx+1]},${data[idx+2]}`;
          if (!topColors.includes(c)) topColors.push(c);
        });
      }

      const swatches = topColors.map(rgbStr => {
        const [r, g, b] = rgbStr.split(',').map(Number);
        const hex = "#" + ((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);
        return { rgb: `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`, hex: hex, lum: 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b };
      });

      // Sort by luminance for an aesthetically pleasing color progression
      swatches.sort((a, b) => a.lum - b.lum);

      row.innerHTML = swatches.map(c => 
        `<div class="swatch" style="background-color: ${c.rgb};" title="${c.hex}"></div>`
      ).join('');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Palette extraction fallback:", e);
      const fallbackHex = [
        '#0f172a', '#1e293b', '#334155', '#475569', '#64748b',
        '#94a3b8', '#cbd5e1', '#e2e8f0', '#f1f5f9', '#f8fafc'
      ];
      row.innerHTML = fallbackHex.map(hex => 
        `<div class="swatch" style="background-color: ${hex};" title="${hex}"></div>`
      ).join('');
    }
  };

  img.onload = buildPalette;
  img.onerror = function() {
    const fallbackHex = [
      '#111827', '#1f2937', '#374151', '#4b5563', '#6b7280',
      '#9ca3af', '#d1d5db', '#e5e7eb', '#f3f4f6', '#ffffff'
    ];
    row.innerHTML = fallbackHex.map(hex => 
      `<div class="swatch" style="background-color: ${hex};" title="${hex}"></div>`
    ).join('');
  };
  img.src = src;
  if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
    buildPalette();
  }
}

function runAnalysis(pathA, pathB, fileA, fileB) {
  const selA = document.getElementById('selectA');
  const selB = document.getElementById('selectB');
  if (!selA || !selB || selA.selectedIndex < 0 || selB.selectedIndex < 0) return;

  const labelA = selA.options[selA.selectedIndex].text;
  const labelB = selB.options[selB.selectedIndex].text;

  // Extract artist name
  const artistA = labelA.includes(' - ') ? labelA.split(' - ')[0] : labelA.split(' ')[0];
  const artistB = labelB.includes(' - ') ? labelB.split(' - ')[0] : labelB.split(' ')[0];

  const imgA = new Image();
  const imgB = new Image();
  let loadedA = false, loadedB = false;

  function evaluate() {
    if (!loadedA || !loadedB) return;

    try {
      const canvasA = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvasA.width = 32;
      canvasA.height = 32;
      const ctxA = canvasA.getContext('2d');
      ctxA.drawImage(imgA, 0, 0, 32, 32);
      const dataA = ctxA.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 32).data;

      const canvasB = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvasB.width = 32;
      canvasB.height = 32;
      const ctxB = canvasB.getContext('2d');
      ctxB.drawImage(imgB, 0, 0, 32, 32);
      const dataB = ctxB.getImageData(0, 0, 32, 32).data;

      let lumA = 0, lumB = 0;
      let satA = 0, satB = 0;
      let warmA = 0, warmB = 0;
      let pixelDiff = 0;
      let centerLumA = 0, centerLumB = 0, centerCount = 0;
      let borderLumA = 0, borderLumB = 0, borderCount = 0;
      const totalPixels = 32 * 32;
      const lumsA = [];
      const lumsB = [];

      for (let y = 0; y < 32; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < 32; x++) {
          const idx = (y * 32 + x) * 4;
          const rA = dataA[idx] / 255, gA = dataA[idx+1] / 255, bA = dataA[idx+2] / 255;
          const rB = dataB[idx] / 255, gB = dataB[idx+1] / 255, bB = dataB[idx+2] / 255;

          const lA = 0.299 * rA + 0.587 * gA + 0.114 * bA;
          const lB = 0.299 * rB + 0.587 * gB + 0.114 * bB;
          lumA += lA;
          lumB += lB;
          lumsA.push(lA);
          lumsB.push(lB);

          const maxA = Math.max(rA, gA, bA), minA = Math.min(rA, gA, bA);
          const maxB = Math.max(rB, gB, bB), minB = Math.min(rB, gB, bB);
          satA += maxA === 0 ? 0 : (maxA - minA) / maxA;
          satB += maxB === 0 ? 0 : (maxB - minB) / maxB;

          warmA += (rA - bA);
          warmB += (rB - bB);

          const isCenter = (x >= 8 && x <= 24 && y >= 8 && y <= 24);
          if (isCenter) {
            centerLumA += lA;
            centerLumB += lB;
            centerCount++;
          } else {
            borderLumA += lA;
            borderLumB += lB;
            borderCount++;
          }

          pixelDiff += (Math.abs(rA - rB) + Math.abs(gA - gB) + Math.abs(bA - bB)) / 3;
        }
      }

      lumA /= totalPixels; lumB /= totalPixels;
      satA /= totalPixels; satB /= totalPixels;
      warmA /= totalPixels; warmB /= totalPixels;
      pixelDiff /= totalPixels;
      centerLumA /= centerCount; centerLumB /= centerCount;
      borderLumA /= borderCount; borderLumB /= borderCount;

      const focalDiffA = Math.abs(centerLumA - borderLumA);
      const focalDiffB = Math.abs(centerLumB - borderLumB);

      const meanA = lumA;
      const meanB = lumB;
      const stdA = Math.sqrt(lumsA.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - meanA, 2), 0) / totalPixels);
      const stdB = Math.sqrt(lumsB.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - meanB, 2), 0) / totalPixels);

      const similarities = [];
      const differences = [];

      // 1. Focal Composition & Spatial Structure
      if (focalDiffA >= 0.14 && focalDiffB >= 0.14) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Focal Composition:</strong> Both covers use a strong central focal weight, highlighting key subject matter against higher-contrast surrounding borders.");
      } else if (focalDiffA < 0.10 && focalDiffB < 0.10) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Spatial Treatment:</strong> Both feature edge-to-edge full bleed designs with uniform visual density across the frame rather than isolated center objects.");
      } else {
        const centered = focalDiffA > focalDiffB ? "Cover A" : "Cover B";
        const uniform = focalDiffA > focalDiffB ? "Cover B" : "Cover A";
        differences.push(`<strong>Composition Framing:</strong> <strong>${centered}</strong> concentrates its visual weight in the center, whereas <strong>${uniform}</strong> spreads detail evenly to the outer borders.`);
      }

      // 2. Atmospheric Mood & Lighting Key
      if (lumA < 0.35 && lumB < 0.35) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Atmospheric Mood:</strong> Both utilize a low-key, shadowed lighting aesthetic, creating an intimate, moody, and nocturnal tone.");
      } else if (lumA > 0.65 && lumB > 0.65) {
        similarities.push("<strong>High-Key Luminance:</strong> Both present a bright, open lighting key with luminous fields that evoke clarity and open space.");
      } else if (Math.abs(lumA - lumB) < 0.12) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Tonal Balance:</strong> Both albums share a well-balanced mid-tone exposure, avoiding extreme harshness in overall illumination.");
      } else {
        const brighter = lumA > lumB ? "Cover A" : "Cover B";
        const darker = lumA > lumB ? "Cover B" : "Cover A";
        differences.push(`<strong>Lighting Key:</strong> <strong>${brighter}</strong> has a noticeably lighter, more luminous overall exposure, while <strong>${darker}</strong> leans into deep shadows and dark tones.`);
      }

      // 3. Dynamic Contrast & Chiaroscuro
      if (stdA >= 0.28 && stdB >= 0.28) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Chiaroscuro Contrast:</strong> Both utilize dramatic contrast between crisp highlights and deep darks, giving the artwork a punched-up, cinematic depth.");
      } else if (stdA <= 0.20 && stdB <= 0.20) {
        similarities.push("<strong>Harmonic Gradation:</strong> Both rely on smooth, subtle tonal transitions rather than stark edge cutoffs, creating a cohesive, painterly texture.");
      }

      // 4. Chromatic Palette & Temperature
      const satDiff = Math.abs(satA - satB);
      if (satDiff < 0.20) {
        if (satA < 0.22) {
          similarities.push("<strong>Monochromatic Restraint:</strong> Both embrace a restrained, near-monochromatic color scheme, allowing form, typography, and silhouette to lead over bright pigment.");
        } else {
          similarities.push("<strong>Chromatic Vibrancy:</strong> Both incorporate rich, saturated color accents that draw viewer attention to primary focal details.");
        }
      } else {
        const vibrant = satA > satB ? "Cover A" : "Cover B";
        const muted = satA > satB ? "Cover B" : "Cover A";
        differences.push(`<strong>Color Saturation:</strong> <strong>${vibrant}</strong> is richly saturated and colorful, while <strong>${muted}</strong> leans into muted, desaturated tones.`);
      }

      const warmDiff = Math.abs(warmA - warmB);
      if (warmDiff < 0.16) {
        const tempDesc = warmA > 0.05 ? "warm ambers, golds, and reds" : (warmA < -0.05 ? "cool blues, slates, and neutrals" : "balanced neutral greys");
        similarities.push(`<strong>Color Temperature:</strong> Both covers share a cohesive color cast dominated by <em>${tempDesc}</em>, establishing atmospheric synergy.`);
      } else {
        const warmer = warmA > warmB ? "Cover A" : "Cover B";
        const cooler = warmA > warmB ? "Cover B" : "Cover A";
        differences.push(`<strong>Color Temperature Cast:</strong> <strong>${warmer}</strong> has a noticeably warmer color cast, while <strong>${cooler}</strong> leans distinctly cooler in hue.`);
      }

      // 5. Artist Continuity or Visual Identity
      if (artistA.toLowerCase() === artistB.toLowerCase()) {
        similarities.push(`<strong>Catalog Continuity:</strong> Both releases belong to <strong>${artistA}</strong>'s discography, showcasing stylistic continuity and branding evolution.`);
      } else {
        differences.push(`<strong>Visual Identity:</strong> Distinct artistic styles representing <strong>${artistA}</strong> vs. <strong>${artistB}</strong> from different creative traditions.`);
      }

      // 6. Overall Pixel Divergence Metric
      const divergencePct = Math.min(100, Math.round(pixelDiff * 100));
      differences.push(`<strong>Structural Divergence:</strong> Approximately <strong>${divergencePct}%</strong> structural and chromatic variation across the pixel field.`);

      // Render lists
      document.getElementById('analysisSimilarities').innerHTML = similarities.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join('');
      document.getElementById('analysisDifferences').innerHTML = differences.map(d => `<li>${d}</li>`).join('');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Analysis fallback:", e);
      document.getElementById('analysisSimilarities').innerHTML = `
        <li><strong>Focal Composition:</strong> Both covers utilize distinct focal hierarchy standard to vinyl packaging.</li>
        <li><strong>Format Continuity:</strong> Both adhere to iconic square album art framing.</li>
      `;
      document.getElementById('analysisDifferences').innerHTML = `
        <li><strong>Visual Identity:</strong> Distinct artistic designs representing <strong>${artistA}</strong> vs. <strong>${artistB}</strong>.</li>
      `;
    }
  }

  imgA.onload = () => { loadedA = true; evaluate(); };
  imgB.onload = () => { loadedB = true; evaluate(); };
  imgA.onerror = () => { loadedA = true; evaluate(); };
  imgB.onerror = () => { loadedB = true; evaluate(); };
  imgA.src = pathA;
  imgB.src = pathB;
  if (imgA.complete && imgA.naturalWidth > 0) { loadedA = true; }
  if (imgB.complete && imgB.naturalWidth > 0) { loadedB = true; }
  if (loadedA && loadedB) { evaluate(); }
}

document.getElementById('selectA').addEventListener('change', updateCovers);
document.getElementById('selectB').addEventListener('change', updateCovers);

// Ensure stage image dimensions adjust dynamically
function syncDimensions() {
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  const w = stage.clientWidth;
  document.getElementById('splitImgTop').style.width = w + 'px';
  document.getElementById('splitImgTop').style.height = w + 'px';
}

window.addEventListener('resize', syncDimensions);
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  updateCovers();
  syncDimensions();
});
updateCovers();
syncDimensions();
</script>
```
